Aj ma apko apny sabsy bary aur famous project ky baary ma batana chahta hon wo project jisky name sy aj meri pehchaan bani ha wo project jo logon ki zubaan per aik brand ki trhan yaad ha mera sabsy zabardast project , bussiness aur favorite and the name I think you know the name is Farhan Deals . 
Yes Farhan Deals The one of the most popular my online business .

Ye Farhan deals shuru sy hi asaani sy ni bana tha isky peechy kaafi interesting 😄 story ha jo aj ma apko sunao ga 💖 

Ye kahani shuru hoti ha December 2025 sy waisy tu is sy pehly bhi ma dhoondh rha tha ky akhir kiya karon online bussiness mujhy kuch ni pta tha ky akhir online kaam hota kaisy ha 😄 agar sach kahon tu ye mujhy impossible bhi lagta tha lekin mery father as you know ranger officer han tu wo mujhy har waqt ye kehty thy freelancing karo , online kaam karo,  apny paisy khud kamao aur isky liye wo jab bhi weekends ma aty tu mujhy bahir ly jaty koi institutes dhoondhny ky kahin tu koi online skills sikhata hoga lekin poora poora din waste karny ky baad hamein ni milta tha tu abu mery sath gusa hoty ky tum yahan rehty ho tumhy ye ni pta ky institute kahan ha pata karo aur aisy hi poora poora din ma lectures sunta tha abu ky gusa bhi ata  tha lekin chup rehta tha ma ky akhir kiya karon jab mil hi ni rha tu kahan sy dhoondho gusa bhi ata tha lekin kya karta 
Han is sy pehly ki baat ha jab mera abu yahan chuttiyon ma aya tha aur by chance pta chala tha ky aik jaga Amazon e commerce ka kaam sikhaty han tu ma abu ky sath gya wahan aur admission wagaira liya aur details liye 5 hazaar fees thi tu abu ny advance fees dy dii ma ny 1 din liya lecture wahan projectile camera jaisa tha shayad pta ni kaisa tha I think kuch aisa tha ky aik dewar per full led type dikha rhy thy jis ma Amazon khul tha aur koi code likh rhy thy 😄 means mujhy yaad ha ky har country ka koi code likhty thy tu saari settings ya kuch change hota tha Amazon countries ky hisaab sy 😄 shayad badlty thy ye mujhy ni pta kaafi purani baat ha na bas yehi yaad ha tu mujhy kuch smjh ni ai thi 1 din gya 2sry din gya 3sry din gya aur bas 😄 Phir ni gya abu ko kaha mujhy kuch smjh ni ati ye buhut advanced ha kuch smjh ni ati aur wahan waisy bhi mujh sy bari  age ky students thy 😄 ma chota sa lagta tha tu abu gusa bhi hwa tha aur phir abu wahan gya fees wapis leny tu unhon ny ni di aur kaha ky ya tu bachy ka admission karwao ya kisi aur ka admission karwao tu bas phir ni liye paisy 

Ab aty han wapis December ky mahiny ma taqreeban akhir 15 dino ki baat ha jab ma aik raat Reels scrolling kar rha tha aur aik ad aya ky shopify dropshipping seekho bilkul free wo bhi online aur gurrentee dy rhy thy ky income start ho jaye gii tu ma ny unsy whatsapp per contact kiya tu unhon ny whatsapp channel ka link diya us ma main add hwa phir channel main ye link dety thy live bhi dety link youtube channel ka agar live class miss hogya tu YouTube per wo full lecture mil jata tha raat ko lecture dety thy live 8 sy 9 tak aur subha dosra full lecture link dety ma isi trhan kabhi live tu kabhi uploaded lectures 😄 sunta tha aur daily wo jo jo main main samjhaya thy wo homework dety thy jaisy 1st day Facebook page banana aur insta ky sath connect karna portfolio banana aur product hunt karna wagaira aur channel jo tha whatsapp wahan hum sab share karty thy ky jaisy koi agar masla hoky portfolio kaisy bany ga ya matlab koi bhi issue howa tu hamara issue solve karny ky  liye number diya gya tha tu wo solve kar dety thy access bhi di thii ma ny tu unhon ny khud portfolio aur ads wagaira ki settings kar dii thii aur taqreeban 8 sy 9 lectures thy total aj bhi youtube per Saad Bashir name ky channel per videos pari hongii tu jab akhiri lectures thy tu unhon ny kaha ky ab hum ny taqreeban sab kuch siikha diya ha baaki ab ap khud smjh sakty han ky ye kaam kaisy shuru karna ha tu agar phir bhi kisi ko confusion ho aur wo start karna chahta ha tu wo 15000 bhyjj dy aur phir hamein unhon ny kaha ky 15000 ma ye ye apko kaam karky diye jayein gy matlab ky agar kahon tu wo 15000 ma custom domain bhi buy karky laga dein gy aur shopify store bhi bana dein gy aur testing 2 3 ads bhi chala dein gy means ky startup bana kar dein  gy tu ma ny bhi yehi choose kiya aur jaisa ky unhon ny bataya ky 2 2 hazaar har kaam hony ky baad is number per bhyj dena ma ny bhi bhyj diye tu kaam hota rha aur 10000 bhyjyy aur akhiri 5000 rehty tu wo kehty ky ab 2 hazaar hamary pass bhyjoo aur 3000 apny bank account ya sadapay ya nayapay per daalon taky ads lagayein tu mery pass nayapay ni tha sadapay bhi aur bank account bhi ni tha phir kaafi confusion ky baad ghr ami wala bank account yaad aya phir usy use kiya tu us ma international transactions off thi lekin ma baar baar connect karny ki koshish karta rha jis sy wo bank account permanent block hogya phir dobara tension  ab tak ma ny 12000 unko dy dita tha aur shopify store bhi custom domain ky sath ready thii aur portfolio ads ky liye insta aur Facebook connect tha ab  bas ye kaam rehta tha taky ma ads laga sakon dun tha 3 January 2026 ab sab kuch ready bas ads lagnay ky liye ma bhi preshaan tha aur wo agency waly bhi wo pressure daal rhy thy ky kahin sy bhi bank account Lao taky ad lagayein aur apka kaam final kiya jaye tu wo last date dety rhy 10 January aur phir 15 ko last date kehty rhy ma ny buhut koshish ki sadapay banany ki koshish ki ami ky cnic per tu face verification ma issue arha tha pta ni camera kharab tha ya koi aur masla tha phir akhir kaar thak kar ma ny sadaypay sy haar maan lii phira ny nayapay try kiya us per bhi mushkil sy verification tu hogai aur ma ghr tha ni aur nayapay ki traf sy call ai aur meri ami ny pata ni kiya kiya baat kii aur confuse hogai ky kya kehna ha tu nayapay walon ny account block kar diya tu wo ni bana phir aik akhiri reh gya tha abu ka bank account akhir ma aur abu ka bhi wahi issue aya tu block hogya means ky taqreeban har baar main kisi na kisi waja sy ruk jata tha aur phir buhut try karny ky baad akhir ma ny haar maan  lii aur unko jo agency waly thy jin ky 3 hazaaar abhi deny thy unko ma ny kaha ap bas mera kaam khatam kar do ma bank account abhi ni ha baad ma bana lon ga tu khud setup bana lon ga darasal mera cnic ni tha tu bank account ni ban sakta tha aur phir ma ny kaafi arsy tak soochta rha ky agar ab ad na laga tu 12000 gye tu yaad aya chacho ky bank account ki check book ma ny dekhii thii ghr ma kahin bachpan ma tu usy dhoondha tu akhir mil gai tu chachu sy discuss kiya tu us ny kaha ye kaafi arsa bank account use ni kiya  tha tu ye band karwa diya tha tu ma ny kaha isy active karwao mery kaam ata ha jitny paisy lagein ma lagaon ga tu chachu ky sath bank ky 2 4 chakar lagaye jis ma taqreeban 1 month lag gya phir unhon ny kaha bank account ab active ha lekin mujhy atm 🏧 card ki zaroorat thii tu atm card us ma ni tha usy dobara registered karna tha means ky atm card per mazeed 1 month lag gya aur phir final atm card active kiya aur phir us sy ads lagaye tu successfully lag gya aur 2 3 din lagye tu 1 2 customers bhi ay thy tu bas phir sy start hogya aur ab tak bhi ma usi chachu ka bank account use kar rha hon aur abhi bhi main 18+ ni hwa tu 😄 bank account ni bana abhi 18 saal ka hon aj 12 November 2026 ha aur ma ny cnic verification dy dii ha aur ab kuch dinon ma ban jaye ga aur cnic usky baad phir bank account ky liye apply karon ga 😄 tu bas yehi story thii aur main waja bhi yehi ha jis waja sy ma ny apny bussiness ko limited rakha ha aur isi chachu ky account sy bhi kuch mushkillat ayein jaisy ky kabhi chachu kaam per hota tha tu kabhi koi verification ma mushkil hoti tu kabhi achanak balance zero tu ad chalta chalata block means aisy issues buhut ayein han is sy ye baat sabit hoti ha ky har kaam mushkil sy start  hota ha aur har kaam jaisa dikhta ha waisa ni hota jitna easy koi kaam lagta ha utna ni hota kuch aisy difficulties ati han jisy hum pehly imagine bhi ni kar sakty tu aj 11 November ko mera shopify store band ha taky mujhy fees na deni pary aur han aik Gmail sy shopify aik store 3 month 1 dollar lety han usky baad taqreeban 20 dollar confirm ni pta tu ma ny 😄 1 Gmail per 3 month 4 month sy ma ny 2sri Gmail per 😄 dobara ban kar aur jab teesri baari ai tu ma ny ab khatam kar ky uski copy save kar rakhi ha aur ab sirf social accounts sy 😄 e commerce karta hon without website ky abhi waisy usko dekh tu sakty han shopify store ko farhandeals.store per ja kar password 1 likhny sy open ho jaye gii kuch shopping wagaira tu workable ni ha magar copy save ha 😄 yehi achi baat ha aur ab tak aisy reh rha hon taky jab mera cnic bany ga phir bank account apna banao ga phir 😄 professionally apna kaam start karon ga inshallah aur mujhy ye bhi pta ha jitna simple ma smjh rha hon itna simple ni hoga lekin allah kary jaisa soocha ha asaani sy ho jaye .
